hack.root_cause: Flash loan + fake token injection → missing mintMultiple() validation → reentrancy → rebase inflation → drain
hack.description: Origin Protocol's OUSD lost $7.7M when a gas-optimization refactor accidentally removed a single validation check, letting an attacker pass a fake stablecoin into mintMultiple(), trigger reentrancy, inflate the total OUSD supply, and redeem more than the vault held.
